items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; associated with the transmitted Shuowen tradition, not a dated artifact
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 面 in Shuowen seal-script style. The face graph is interpreted in the CUHK database as an outline enclosing an eye.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 面, shown as a modern vector drawing.
items.selection_reason: Shows a later script-style form of the entry character after the reported oracle-bone pictograph; helps distinguish a modern redraw from an artifact photograph.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the Commons description page; attribution appreciated but not required.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; the dictionary identifies 麪 as the Shuowen form and 麵 as a later common spelling
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 麵 in Shuowen seal-script style. The Ministry dictionary records 麪 as the Shuowen graph, with 麥 for meaning and 丏 for sound, and 麵 as a later writing.
items.alt: Black seal-script form labeled 麵, shown as a modern vector drawing.
items.selection_reason: Illustrates the separate flour/food graph history relevant to distinguishing 面’s face graph from 麵 and its simplified writing use; the caption preserves the source’s caveat that this redraw is associated with the 面 page.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the Commons description page; attribution appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: Both candidates are modern vector redrawings, not photographs or direct facsimiles of dated artifacts. Their exact original-file links were established through the inspected Commons pages but could not be fetched by the web tool, so the pixels were not inspected.
